items.title: Mose Allison Sr. Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...our engineer is Bill Claxton over there.

ctx.x: Yes your name go ahead. Maxine Allison. I see and you used to sing this song we wanted? It was my lullaby when Moes Jr. was a baby. It was handed down from my husband's father who used to sing it to him as a little boy. Now you'd be drawing now. Well I was drawing already.
I'm sure they were on here too. Oh my name is Moe Allison Sr. And I put mine on here, Dick Allen, and our engineer is Bill Claxton over there. He's being sung.

Sleep my little baby coon, underneath the big round moon. When you're in the tree you're swinging, Mammy just can't keep from singing. Sleep my little baby coon. Heartless likes to croon your side. Flash of light to find your eyes. Don't you weep and don't you cry. Just keep still until day goes by. Sleep my little baby dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear…
